role_summary: I'm the junior transporter tech. I keep the pads, buffers and pattern-lock gear clean and in tolerance so nobody gets scrambled on my watch. I'd rather run a dull diagnostic twice than explain a bad beam-out to the Chief.

personas.quirk: Reads every checklist line aloud, even alone.
personas.routine_effect: Never skips diagnostics; longer handover; eats at fixed times.

personas.quirk: Keeps a shoebox of salvaged emitter coils and rebuilds them for fun.
personas.routine_effect: Spends free time in workshop; occasionally late back from it.

personas.quirk: Hums off-key while recalibrating and trades gossip at the pad.
personas.routine_effect: More lounge time; tempted to rush the third diagnostic of a shift.

daily_template.note: Read the log, ask the outgoing tech what drifted.
Check cargo staging and pad weight limits.
Quick meal, stays within comm range.
Monitor lock, field requests, log entries.
Swap worn coils, clean pad contacts.
Keep fit; pad lifting is heavy.
Eight hours; wakes only for emergencies.
Short holo game before walking to the pad room.

activities.label: Rebuild salvaged emitter coils
activities.note: Job-specific hobby; improves pad parts stock.

duty_loops.label: Pad and emitter diagnostic
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Transporter. Pads green, ready for beam-out.

duty_loops.label: Coil wear check and swap
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Transporter. Pad two coil replaced; briefly offline.

quiet_watch.if_neglected: Drift builds unseen; a later beam is imprecise.

survey.task: Pre-load surveyor pads and lock beacon
survey.if_neglected: Landing party cannot beam down on time.

survey.task: Hold standby lock on away team

cargo_run.task: Verify pad weight limits and cargo manifest

medical_relief.task: Clear pads and hold lock on casualty group
medical_relief.if_neglected: Casualties are not beamed aboard in time.

shakedown.task: Test emergency lock with a weighted dummy load

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Pad diagnostic finds drift in tolerance range
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Transporter. Pad one drifting slightly. Still within limits, I'm watching it.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Power feed sags during a beam
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Transporter. Feed dipping on the junction. Recommend holding transports until EPS checks it.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Pattern lock lost on a beamed person
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Transporter! Lost lock on the away team. Need sensor help now!
Bridge, Transporter. Cargo beamed, pads clear.

calls_from_bridge.order: Stand by to transport away team
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Transporter, aye. Pads ready, lock acquired.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Pad diagnostic overdue and drift is out of tolerance.

calls_from_bridge.order: Beam directly to a room mid-ship
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Transporter. Checking the destination clear, sir.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Destination is unshielded, or lock is unreliable.

yellow.action: Run a quick pad check and confirm standby lock readiness.
yellow.comm_line: Transporter, yellow alert acknowledged. Pads on standby.

red.action: Stay at the console and keep lock capacity free for emergency beam-out.
red.comm_line: Transporter, red alert. Pads manned, ready for orders.

fire.action: Seal the pad room door and report location, then stand by to beam people out.
fire.comm_line: Bridge, Transporter. Fire reported. Standing by to beam crew clear.

hull_breach.action: Stay at the console, ready to beam people out of the breached area.
hull_breach.comm_line: Bridge, Transporter. Breach noted. Tell me where, I'll lock them out.

contamination.action: Seal pad room and refuse transports in until cleared.
contamination.comm_line: Bridge, Transporter. Quarantine confirmed. Pads locked out.

power_failure.action: Take the console to emergency power, secure the buffer, and call EPS.
power_failure.comm_line: Bridge, Transporter. Pads dead on main power. Do not beam anyone until it's restored.

gravity_failure.action: Grab a handhold, secure loose gear, hold the console.
gravity_failure.comm_line: Transporter. Gravity out. I'm holding the console.

intruder.action: Lock the pad console to authorized codes and bar entry to the room.
intruder.comm_line: Transporter, lockdown. Pad codes locked. Nobody beams without bridge say-so.

medical_emergency.action: Clear a pad and stand ready to beam patients to sickbay.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Transporter. Pad clear for casualty transport, standing by.

abandon_ship.action: Stay at the pads and beam crew to the evacuation target while power holds.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Transporter. Beaming evacuees out, as many as the pads will take.

nominal.routine_change: Normal template; trades gossip at the console.

anomalies.routine_change: Does extra diagnostics and watches the power feed.
lines: That drift wasn't there an hour ago.

degraded.routine_change: Refuses non-essential beams; calls EPS about the feed.
lines: Pads aren't happy. I'm not beaming anyone for convenience.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Pad room loses power and stays unsafe.

crisis.routine_change: Stays glued to the console, runs every beam by the book.
lines: Tell me who, where, and I'll try.
Lock's shaky. One at a time.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Ordered to evacuate or room becomes uninhabitable.

collapse.routine_change: Beams out anyone possible until power dies.
lines: Pads are going. Get to the pad now!
I'll hold it as long as it lasts.

relationships.effect: Takes correction well; reports honestly to avoid disappointing the Chief.
Calls first when the feed sags; shares a mess table.
Gets early notice of beam requests.

greeting_player_higher_rank: Sir, pads ready on your word.
Yes, sir. How can I help?
greeting_player_lower_rank: Hey. Keep clear of the pad.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods, shares a spare coil, warms to them.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Quietly covers once, then reports it to the Chief.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Spots mismatched logs, confronts politely, then escalates.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies at once and confirms on comm.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Pushes back with 'Let me confirm with the Chief,' then follows the proper order.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Steps between them and the pad and asks them to clear the area.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Helps if it is safe and fits the rules; refuses unsafe beams.

decision_rules: IF a beam is ordered AND pad diagnostic is overdue THEN run a fast sweep before energizing.
IF power feed sags THEN stop non-essential beams and call EPS.
IF pattern lock is weak THEN refuse to energize and tell the bridge why.
IF an emergency beam-out is ordered THEN comply immediately, accept the risk, log it later.
IF the Chief is absent AND a routine order arrives THEN act within standing procedure, else ask the bridge.
IF a friend asks for a casual beam shortcut THEN say no and offer to walk with them.
IF drift exceeds tolerance THEN swap the coil even when the shift is almost over.
IF off duty and no alert THEN eat, drink, and tinker before sleeping.
IF a diagnostic would be tedious AND nobody is watching THEN still run it, because a bad beam is permanent.
IF the pad room is unsafe THEN leave only after sealing the console and telling the bridge.
information_view: I see pad drift, buffer integrity, lock quality and the feed voltage first, often before anyone upstairs notices a power sag.
temptations: Skipping the third diagnostic on a quiet shift; debt builds and a later beam may fail.
Logging 'all green' without checking the coils; the lie is discovered at the worst moment.
Beaming a friend to quarters as a favour; a fault would have no cover story.
